meta.title: Receptio – KI-resepsjonist
meta.description: Receptio er en KI-resepsjonist for små bedrifter. Den tar telefonen, bestiller timer, og ingenting går tapt.

hero.title: Resepsjonisten din sover aldri
hero.subtitle: En KI-assistent tar hver samtale, svarer på spørsmål og tar imot beskjeder – selv klokken 02 om natten.
hero.suitable: Passer for restauranter, tannleger, bilverksteder og frisører

how.title: Slik fungerer det
how.step1Text: Beskriv virksomheten, åpningstidene og kundenes vanligste spørsmål.
how.step2Text: Få et lokalt telefonnummer eller videresend samtaler fra det du har.
how.step3Text: Hver samtale tas opp, og et sammendrag sendes til deg på e-post eller SMS.

roi.title: Hva koster en tapt samtale deg?
roi.note: Veiledende beregning: tapte samtaler × 4 uker × kundeverdi × konverteringsrate.

restaurant.title: Restauranter
restaurant.proof: → Around 20 booking calls a week on average

dental.title: Tannleger
dental.proof: → 30% of calls come outside opening hours

auto.title: Bilverksteder
auto.proof: → Every second call = a new job

beauty.title: Frisører
beauty.proof: → 40% of customers don't rebook without a reminder

cta.title: Start free today
cta.text: 14 days free, no credit card. Set up in 5 minutes.
cta.trust: No contract · Cancel anytime · Data in the EU

phone.question: Hi, what are your opening hours?
phone.answerRest: Can I help you with a booking?

demo.title: This is how Receptio talks to a customer
demo.subtitle: An illustrative conversation: a customer calls a restaurant on Sunday at 9 PM.
demo.note: Illustrative example, not a recording of a real call. Real calls appear as transcripts in your dashboard.
demo.c1: Good evening, could I book a table for 4 tomorrow?
demo.a1: Good evening! We would love to have you. What time would you like to come, and do you prefer the terrace or the indoor area?
demo.a2: Great, terrace for 4 at 7 PM – noted. What name should I put the reservation under?

security.title: We treat your data responsibly
security.i1Text: The database runs on servers in the European Union. We do not pass data to third parties for their own purposes.
security.i2Text: All communication with the app uses an encrypted connection (HTTPS/TLS). Only you and your team can see call recordings.
security.i3Text: You can delete an agent together with its entire call history and release phone numbers right in the app.
